issues.problem: The official real-defocus configs are per scene and the port hard-codes one of them (cake's). Only cake and daisy use band_limit=true with lambda_mask_loss=0.002. The two other benchmark scenes differ: caps uses band_limit=false and lambda 0.001 (no Mip 3D filter in render, plain reset_opacity); tools uses band_limit=true and lambda 0.001. Over the 9 scenes, lambda is 0.001 for 7 (cisco, cupcake, cups, sausage, seal, tools, caps) and band_limit is false for caps, cupcake and cups. The paper text says lambda_mk=0.001 and lambda_reg=1e-4. So the claim 'mask weights 0.002/0.0002 for real' (paper.md, report.md) is false for 7/9 scenes and for 2 of the 3 planned scenes. As planned, caps and tools would run a config that matches neither the paper nor the official code. There is no CLI override: ss-train/bench.py --extra cannot set component config, and bench_request.json uses the single 'dofgs' method.
issues.evidence: source/code/config_files/config_real_{cake,caps,tools,...}.yaml: cake band_limit true / 0.002; caps false / 0.001; tools true / 0.001; cisco true/0.001; cupcake false/0.001; cups false/0.001; daisy true/0.002; sausage true/0.001; seal true/0.001. training.py:181-193 passes opt.band_limit to both renders; training.py:286-289 switches reset_opacity_with_filter3D vs reset_opacity on band_limit; renderer/__init__.py:63-82 uses raw opacity/scales when band_limit is false. Paper 7-experiment.tex:27 gives lambda_mk=0.001, lambda_reg=0.0001.
issues.fix: Expose the official per-scene configs as method variants (entry points), e.g. 'dofgs' = band_limit true + lambda 0.001 (cisco, sausage, seal, tools); 'dofgs-bl2' = band_limit true + lambda 0.002 (cake, daisy); 'dofgs-nobl' = band_limit false + lambda 0.001 (caps, cupcake, cups). Add a band_limit option to dofgs-density so that, when false, reset uses plain min(sigmoid(o), 0.01) and renderer/density agree. Update bench_request.json so each scene uses its variant, and correct paper.md/report.md.

issues.problem: The description of the optimizer-order difference is inaccurate. In the official loop, densify/prune/reset replaces every Gaussian nn.Parameter (grad=None) before optimizer.step, so on every densification step (every 100 steps, 500-25k) the official run skips the Adam step for ALL Gaussian parameters, not only the new ones. The runtime steps all of them.

issues.fix: Reword the gap (about 245 skipped steps over 40k). Still negligible.

issues.problem: This contradicts report.md and the evidence: only 539 of 60000 candidates survive on cake (smoke-1 counts.extra_added=539). That is consistent with the official code, because the SfM point bbox spans roughly [-100,110]x[-127,29]x[15,291] and the ±25% expansion plus dist_thres 15 rejects most samples.

The official val_real.sh evaluates the re-trained models at cake 15000, caps 15000 and tools 40000; val_real_r1.sh uses different iterations again. This is selection on the test set. The paper states 40,000 iterations, and the original checkpoints are lost (README). Evaluating 40k is correct, but a cake/caps gap may partly come from the authors' checkpoint picking.
issues.fix: Headline = 40k. Optionally save a 15k checkpoint and report its test PSNR as a labeled diagnostic only, never as the result.

probe_assessment.why: Compares against an independent float64 dense renderer and asserts a gap vs a CoC-free render.
Q=0 equals the pinhole reference, the focal plane stays sharp, and off-plane Gaussians must blur.
The fitted variance must equal sigma'^2+0.1+R^2/(2ln4) and grow with aperture.
F/K gradients are checked against float64 autograd; a nonzero condition rules out a degenerate fixture.
Independent numpy init; schedule asserts accumulation before 100 and freeze at 15000.
Architecture shapes, Pearson/entropy values vs numpy, and gradient routing vs the two official backwards.
Warm-up must equal L_rec; dropping the AiF branch changes the loss.
Checks extra-point count/IDW, compactness math, clone/split/prune counts, reset ceiling and xyz LR at 40k. It does not check per-scene band_limit/lambda.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Vendored DOF CUDA rasterizer byte-identical to source/code/submodules/diff-gaussian-rasterization-dof (all .cu/.h/.cpp, glm, stbi).

Training views are rendered defocused with per-view (f_m,Q_m) found by viewmat match against the bank. Every other camera (test, the validation copies, and ss-eval where ACTIVE=None) is rendered AiF with K=0, as in the official training_report/render.py test path. The bank cannot reach test views: there is no viewmat match and the bank is absent in ss-eval.

Bank schedule matches official: grads accumulate over steps 1-99; Adam (eps 1e-15, lr 0.05/0.01) steps from 100 using the accumulated grads; the step-15000 update is applied and then frozen (official requires_grad_(False) comes before that iteration's optimizer.step, which still uses the existing grad).
Objective: L_rec (0.8 L1 + 0.2 (1-SSIM same-pad)) up to step 5000, then L_a + L_b + mask terms; detached tensors and the means2D-gradient source match the official code.

Density matches official: percent_dense 0.03, grad 2e-4, densify 500<step<25000 every 100, prune raw opacity < 0.005, no size/world prune (use_size_prune false -> size_threshold None, so the max_radii2D-zeroing quirk is irrelevant and correctly absent), compactness every 1000 with raw log-scale/1.5 quirk and discarded shrink, extra points at 2000 (539/60000 survive on cake, consistent with official), filter recompute schedule, xyz LR 5e-4->5e-6 over max_steps 80000 (5e-5*extent at 40k), scaling lr 0.01, 40000 steps.

Data: PIL default-bicubic resize of 2400x1600 images/ to 600x400 (round(W/4)), names sorted, idx % hold == 0 -> test with official holdouts (cake 9, caps 5, cisco 7, cupcake 6, cups 8, daisy 8, sausage 6, seal 6, tools 7); translate/extent from training cameras only; no world reorientation in the converter. Validation = copies of test, used only by the runtime's end-of-training measure (no selection).
paper_results.json matches supp. tables/table_real_new.tex (DOF-GS and Mip-Splatting rows, all 9 scenes plus averages).

Official val scripts pick per-scene iterations (cake 15k, caps 15k, tools 40k in val_real.sh): test-set selection on re-trained models. The paper states 40k, so final-40k evaluation is the correct protocol.
Runtime gaps: sampling with replacement, optimizer step before densification, last-step skip absent, SH degree raised one step late, valid-conv SSIM metric (only PSNR comparable).
summary: The port is faithful operator by operator. The kernel is vendored byte-identical, the renderer's training/test routing matches the official evaluation, and the bank schedule, objective, ILN, densification, data split and targets are all verified against cfd635c. One major problem blocks approval: the official configs are per scene, and the plugin hard-codes cake's (band_limit=true, lambda_mask=0.002). As planned, caps (official band_limit=false, lambda 0.001) and tools (lambda 0.001) would run a configuration that matches neither the official code nor the paper (lambda 0.001), and the runtime has no way to override it per scene. Add per-config method variants (with a density band_limit switch for plain opacity reset) and map each scene to its variant before benchmarking.
